notes.title: Week Two Big update!
notes.content:
Week Two Update
Today we have updated the game with some cool things. Here is what we did:

 First of all the game now 100% supports Steam Deck. We are happy to see you play Fetish Locator on it!
 Finally fixed all the missing Italian translations and added German and Malay language support! Hooray! 
 Made some improvements for the questionnaire to be more restrictive, but safe players from selecting wrong fetishes.
 Fixed some minor bugs and misspellings.

Week-3
We are working on week-3 full speed. There is still a long way to go. This would be the last part of the Fetish Locator trilogy, and we are making sure it will be awesome!
If you want to know about how week-3 development is going - make sure you follow our updates on the Cross-Promotion Posts, they aren't visible in your game library.

Upcoming Future
Also starting on the 13-th of March and for several weeks we will be dropping very cool news, so make sure to follow our social media!
